text: now if you look at this graph you will
see that the average monthly salary in
India is roughly 45,000 rupees if you
start comparing it to Singapore or
Switzerland then there the salary is 10
times more so such comparisons do not
make any sense but a more relevant
question to ask is that hey is 45,000
rupe good enough in a country like India
well again the answer is it depends for
example if you're living in cities like
Mumbai or Delhi or G the cost of living
is very very high your rent can easily
be 25 30,000 rupes sending your kids to
school can easily cost above 20,000
rupees a month on the flip side if
you're living in tier 2 tier 3 cities
then your cost of living can easily be
30% less so an important exercise for
you is to do a lifestyle expense
calculation all of us keep on thinking
about whether our salary is good or not
it is very very important to consider in
what context where is it that you will
eventually be spending that salary
